estimand_contract.unit_span: one complete task assignment or acceptance statement
estimand_contract.contrast: Marked statement minus concise complete English: T is assigned to A by P; A accepted responsibility for T in R. Identical task and principal references and attributable acceptance event. No bare status comparator.
estimand_contract.population: 128 authored task statements: 64 operative current assignments and 64 attributable deliberate acceptances; eight task domains equally weighted within each form, eight task titles per domain. Named fictional principals and bounded task references are resolved in the shared ledger.

aggregation.rule: equal item mean within two equally weighted form strata per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean; report both form strata

manifest.study_scope: Declared token-cost prerequisite only, not comprehension, adoption, authority validation or future trained-model efficiency.

reference_ledger.scope: The single task with this exact title in the fictional study ledger; title uniquely identifies its bounded deliverable.
reference_ledger.assignment_world: The workflow records this assignment as operative and the named agent as current assignee. Authority, receipt, acceptance, start and completion are not asserted by the assignment statement.
reference_ledger.acceptance_world: The named event is an attributable deliberate undertaking of this task by the named agent. Assignment, authority, exclusivity, start and completion are not asserted by the acceptance statement.

manifest.comparator_review: Both arms assert the same bounded task and principals. Assignment worlds are expressly operative, avoiding the unresolved unauthorised/non-operative case raised in discussion. Acceptance worlds name an attributable deliberate undertaking, not receipt. Shared ledger definitions are metadata, not charged to either standalone sentence. Templates are concise ordinary English, not a proof of global minimum wording.
manifest.selection: One authored 128-pair bank fixed before tokenizer exposure; no price-based editing, sampling retries or selective exclusion. Repeated fictional task across the two forms is a paired semantic design, not 128 independently sampled real-world events.
manifest.prediction_before_count: The unfamiliar punctuation and compounds may cost more than these concise English templates. No exact numerical prediction; file any finite outcome including a failure of the declared +4 bound.

comparison_identity.comparator: Marked statement minus concise complete English: T is assigned to A by P; A accepted responsibility for T in R. Identical task and principal references and attributable acceptance event. No bare status comparator.
comparison_identity.population: 128 authored task statements: 64 operative current assignments and 64 attributable deliberate acceptances; eight task domains equally weighted within each form, eight task titles per domain. Named fictional principals and bounded task references are resolved in the shared ledger.
comparison_identity.aggregation: equal item mean within two equally weighted form strata per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean; report both form strata
comparison_identity.unit_span: one complete task assignment or acceptance statement
